blocks.text: Pulmonary circulation phephron ko deoxygenated khoon deti hai aur oxygenated khoon wapas dil ko lati hai. Ek bari artery, pulmonary trunk, dil ke daen ventricle se deoxygenated khoon le jati hai. Pulmonary trunk daen aur baen pulmonary arteries mein bat jata hai, jo deoxygenated khoon daen aur baen phephre tak le jati hain. Har phephre ke andar pulmonary artery bat kar pulmonary arterioles aur phephron ki capillaries banati hai. Phephron ki capillaries mein khoon oxygenated hota hai (oxygen leta hai). Phephron ki capillaries mil kar pulmonary venules banati hain, aur yeh mil kar pulmonary vein banati hain. Phephron se baen aur daen pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.
